WITH player_avg_doubles AS (
  SELECT 
    player_id,
    AVG(double) as avg_doubles
  FROM batting_postseason
  WHERE double IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY player_id
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_doubles) as overall_avg_doubles
  FROM player_avg_doubles
),
player_index AS (
  SELECT 
    pad.player_id,
    pad.avg_doubles,
    pad.avg_doubles / oa.overall_avg_doubles as index_value
  FROM player_avg_doubles pad
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
),
player_with_hand AS (
  SELECT 
    pi.player_id,
    p.bats,
    pi.avg_doubles,
    pi.index_value
  FROM player_index pi
  JOIN player p ON pi.player_id = p.player_id
),
hand_avg_index AS (
  SELECT 
    bats,
    AVG(index_value) as avg_index_for_hand
  FROM player_with_hand
  GROUP BY bats
),
final_result AS (
  SELECT 
    pwh.player_id,
    pwh.bats,
    pwh.avg_doubles,
    pwh.index_value,
    pwh.index_value - hai.avg_index_for_hand as gap
  FROM player_with_hand pwh
  LEFT JOIN hand_avg_index hai ON pwh.bats = hai.bats
)
SELECT 
  player_id,
  bats,
  avg_doubles,
  index_value,
  gap
FROM final_result
ORDER BY gap DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
